results.name: Juicy Salif
results.description:
When life gives you lemons, make lemonade! Philippe Starck's Juicy Salif is probably the most controversial lemon squeezer design out there. The Juicy Salif became a bestselling item for Alessi and a Design icon of the late 20th century for its futuristic and disruptive look. However, its functionality is debatable. On that matter, Starck stated that the intent behind the product was to inspire conversation rather than to be functional. With that, the designer implies that objects can have emotional functions as well as practical ones. And that products can be signified from other perspectives such as from the symbolic, philosophical, and cultural levels. This explains why Juicy Salif still remains a treasured decoration item for Design enthusiasts all around the world.

results.name: Lemon-Poppy Calligraphy School
results.description:
~*Welcome to the lemon-poppy calligraphy school. 
Squeeze some lemons and write secret letters to your friends!*~

My entry for #CalligraphySchoolChallenge

I chose a bright, bold comic look.
I made the wireframe visible and colored it yellow to create some kind of outline.
As light I took one direcional light source.
And then I mostly changed the color of the materials to red, blue and yellow.
Finally I added some Effects like animated grain and chromatic aberration.

results.name: Hero Citrus Honey Squeeze- 500 Gm
results.description: Citrus flower honey is a unique and prized type of honey known for its sweet, delicate flavor and bright aroma. It is produced by bees that collect nectar from citrus blossoms such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruits. The production of citrus flower honey requires dedicated and skilled beekeepers who understand the unique needs of the bees and the flowering patterns of the citrus trees. These producers work hard to ensure that the hives are placed in prime locations for foraging, and that the bees have access to the right types of blossoms at the right time. The result of their efforts is a delicious, high-quality honey that is prized by honey connoisseurs and appreciated by anyone who loves the taste of fresh, natural sweetness.
